# hypo_incremental_cases.txt -- cases for the incremental hypo-kernel entry (WP-232b).
# Interface: tests/mpm_interface.md section 8. Format version: hypo-incremental-cases 1.
#
# FORMAT (line based, ASCII):
#   '#' starts a comment line; blank lines are ignored.
#   'case' opens a block, 'endcase' closes it. Inside, every line is '<key> <tokens...>'.
#   Numeric tokens are C/Python floats (%.17e). The bare token 'pending-oracle' means the
#   value is filled by the numpy oracle in phase 2 (tests/hypo_incremental_reference.py).
#   Keys:
#     name    <id>
#     dim     3 | 2            (2 = plane strain, section 8.3)
#     Fn      dim*dim floats   row-major, F[i][j] = dx_i/dX_j
#     F1      dim*dim floats   row-major
#     status  0 | -1           the entry's return code (-1: det F_mid <= 0 or det F1 <= 0)
#     deps    6 | 3 floats     unrotated-frame strain increment, Voigt, ENGINEERING shear
#                              3D [xx yy zz xy yz zx]; plane strain [xx yy xy]
#     R1      dim*dim floats   row-major, polar rotation of F1
#     J1      1 float          det F1
#     shat    6 | 3 floats     (optional) an unrotated-frame stress, Voigt, tensor shear
#     scauchy 6 | 3 floats     (optional) R1 shat R1^T in Voigt
#     tol     <abs> <rel>      pass iff |got - exp| <= abs + rel*|exp|, elementwise
#   Absent keys (deps/R1/J1 on a status -1 case) are not compared.
#   'note' lines are free text.
